messages.subject: Middle East Energy & Mining Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations and Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Bradley,

Your executive and board work across energy, infrastructure, mining and metals, oil and gas, and sustainability in the Middle East and Africa makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current responsibilities sit where executive leadership, ministries, regulators, communities, investment priorities, energy transition and complex industrial operations intersect.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across mining, energy, natural resources, infrastructure and industrial development. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming Middle East searches where institutional engagement, sustainability and country-facing leadership are central to the mandate. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
